t: You're standing in Cabot Square, one of the central squares of the Canary Wharf development on the Isle of Dogs. It takes its name from John Cabot, the Italian navigator and explorer, known in Italian as Giovanni Caboto. In 1497 he sailed to the coast of North America under a commission from Henry the Seventh, King of England. That voyage is the earliest known European exploration of coastal North America since the Norse visits to Vinland in the eleventh century. So a square among modern towers carries the name of an early explorer.
